text:
Stop manifesting. Start paying.

You closed your eyes last night and pictured the car, the apartment, the life. Felt good, right?

That feeling is the vision board lie. Picturing the life is not building it.

Success has a real price:

1. Doing the boring work nobody sees.
2. Preparing while your friends party.
3. Searching for answers, not waiting for signs.

Wanting it isn't even 1% of the cost.

The universe doesn't owe you anything. Your sweat is the only currency that counts.
caption:
Success isn't a mindset shift, it's a price tag most men read but never pay. Discipline is how you start.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
